content.text: The forecast module only speaks Celsius. I will read it first, then add a small Fahrenheit helper next to it.
The module exposes `averageTemperatureC` and `describe`. I will add `celsiusToFahrenheit` beside them.
Added `celsiusToFahrenheit(c: number): number` to `src/forecast.ts`. It uses the usual `c * 9 / 5 + 32` formula.
Sure, I will cover the new helper with a test.
Created `src/forecast.test.ts` checking that 0 C is 32 F and 100 C is 212 F.
